title: Labour time per Model T chassis at Highland Park, August 1913 to April 1914
description: Bar chart of minutes of labour per chassis: 748 with stationary assembly in August 1913; 350 with a chassis drawn by rope and windlass; 177 on the first moving line, 7 October 1913; 158 on 1 December 1913; 93 on three chain-driven lines, 30 April 1914. Data: Arnold and Faurote, Ford Methods and the Ford Shops (1915), pp. 136–139.
heading: MINUTES OF LABOUR PER CHASSIS · HIGHLAND PARK
